video.decoding_capability: Live view up to 16 channels of VGA, 4 channels of 720p, or 2 channels of 1080p via HDMI or VGA output

features: Records up to 24 channels of 720p (1280x720) with RAID 0 and 7,200 rpm HDDs, or 16 channels with RAID 1 or 5,400 rpm HDDs; half the channel density at 1080p
Remote live preview of up to 24 cameras at once
Video compression: H.264 baseline, main or high profile; audio G.711 (u-law and a-law), recorded in sync with video
Recording modes: continuous, schedule, event triggered or manual
Motion detection with up to 16 target areas; search by time and date or motion
Supports Grandstream GXV36xx cameras, GXV35xx encoders/decoders and third-party ONVIF cameras; ONVIF 2.2
UPS management; IR remote control; optional USB mouse and keyboard
notes: Datasheet marks the 16-channel figure as applying to light video browsing; heavy browsing or display is subject to the performance constraints in the product FAQ.
1080p recording: datasheet gives half the 720p channel density, user manual specification table gives 12 cameras, user manual feature list gives 14 cameras.
Alarm inputs: datasheet gives 4, user manual gives 16. Alarm input count left out.

Power consumption from the NVR power consumption technical bulletin (HW V1.4A, SW 1.0.0.62): 4.274 W without HDD at idle; 14.67 W with 2 HDDs and 22.67 W with 4 HDDs recording; 65.994 W maximum with 4 HDDs in boot mode.
Datasheet gives package weight 4052.5 g; unit weight not stated.
Datasheet marks third-party ONVIF camera support as pending.
